Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and highly skilled NetSuite Lead/Engineer to drive the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions using NetSuite. This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead complex system integrations, develop innovative solutions, and ensure seamless operations across business functions. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in software development, systems architecture, and enterprise solutions, with a passion for leveraging technology to enhance organizational efficiency and scalability. Join us to be at the forefront of digital transformation, delivering impactful solutions that empower our business growth.

Responsibilities

Lead the architecture, design, and deployment of NetSuite ERP systems, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical standards.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including business analysts, system administrators, and developers—to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
Develop customizations, workflows, scripts (using SuiteScript), and integrations with other enterprise systems such as Salesforce, Pegasystems, and cloud platforms like AWS.
Manage system configurations, version control (using Git or similar tools), and change management processes to maintain system integrity.
Conduct troubleshooting, performance tuning, and security hardening of NetSuite environments; provide ongoing technical support for system issues.
Design and implement data migration strategies using ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes; optimize database systems including MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and NoSQL databases.
Ensure compliance with IT infrastructure standards including network security (firewalls, VPNs), load balancing, cloud security protocols, and disaster recovery plans.

Requirements

Proven experience as a NetSuite Lead or Engineer with extensive knowledge of ERP systems implementation and system integration.
Strong understanding of service-oriented architecture (SOA), solution architecture principles, and enterprise application design.
Proficiency in software development languages such as JavaScript, C#, Python, SQL (T-SQL), PL/SQL; experience with RESTful APIs and web services (SOAP).
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms including AWS or Azure; familiarity with virtualization technologies like VMware or ESXi is a plus.
Solid background in systems engineering covering operating systems (Windows/Linux), network protocols (DNS, DHCP), and system administration tasks.
Expertise in DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or similar tools; experience with container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes is advantageous.
Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices including vulnerability management, threat intelligence, system hardening, and information security standards.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills; ability to analyze requirements thoroughly and translate them into effective technical solutions within Agile or SDLC frameworks.
